headline: insuperabilehart climbs into ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: insuperabilehart gained 2.40 to reach 39.79, climbing from 25th to 13th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move puts the team inside the 19 gold places; the line stands at 38.22.
